#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

class InputReader {
private:
    istream& in;
public:
    InputReader(istream& stream) : in(stream) {}
    
    string next() {
        string s;
        in >> s;
        return s;
    }
    
    int nextInt() {
        int x;
        in >> x;
        return x;
    }
    
    long long nextLong() {
        long long x;
        in >> x;
        return x;
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader in(cin);
    int n = in.nextInt();
    long long b = in.nextLong();
    vector<int> a(n);
    vector<int> c(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        a[i] = in.nextInt();
        if (a[i] % 2 == 0) {
            c[i] = 1;
        } else {
            c[i] = -1;
        }
    }
    long long sum = 0;
    vector<long long> array;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        sum += c[i];
        if (sum == 0) {
            array.push_back(abs(a[i] - a[i+1]));
        }
    }
    sum = 0;
    int count = 0;
    sort(array.begin(), array.end());
    for (size_t i = 0; i < array.size(); i++) {
        sum += array[i];
        if (sum <= b) {
            count++;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
    cout << count << endl;
    return 0;
}
